column3: The Hebrew “my place of refuge, strength” is rendered “my strong fortress,” and “He set free … my way” as “He sets the blameless in His way” (written text “His way”). The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “does” (female deer) is rendered “hinds’ feet.”
“Your answering” is rendered “Your help”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Brought them to an end” is rendered “devoured them.”
“Gave me the neck of my enemies” is rendered “made my enemies turn their backs to me.”
“Cringed to me” is rendered “pretend obedience,” and “to hear of the ear” as “As soon as they hear.”
The Hebrew verb (“girded themselves”) is uncertain; NASB renders “come trembling out.”
Close to the Hebrew; “man of violences” is rendered “the violent man.”
The written Hebrew reads “tower of salvations”; NASB renders “tower of deliverance.” “Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
